sloka: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनम् कैकेयी विरराम ह ।विलपन्तम् च राजानम् न प्रतिव्याजहार सा ॥२-१२-५०॥
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanam kaikeyī virarāma ha ।vilapantam ca rājānam na prativyājahāra sā ॥2-12-50॥

translations.english: Kaikeyi, having spoken to this extent remained silent. She heeded not the lament of the king.
